description.p: Haven is a Matrix-native chat and social client, built on Element Web/Desktop, combining secure end-to-end encrypted messaging with a federated social timeline.

screenshot.caption: The Social feed: federated timeline plus chat

description.p: Fixes and improvements across profiles, room navigation, and the emoji/sticker picker:

ul.li: Fix stale scroll position and HTML bio rendering when navigating profiles
Fix Alt+Up/Down room navigation when no room is currently selected
Add a "Reactions" dialog for viewing who reacted with what
Add a "View Devices" link to a room member's profile
Fix emoji picker tiles not filling their full clickable area
Fix the custom emoji/sticker picker loading full-resolution images
Fix "Create New Pack" wrapping and a double scrollbar in the devices dialog
Fix /me messages with a mention pill wrapping onto a second line
Make the Forward dialog's body/attachment toggles clickable anywhere
Keep the room list's blurred-avatar backdrop bundled regardless of the old room list flag

description.p: A round of fixes focused on the custom emoji/sticker picker and room list:

ul.li: Add a setting to disable the custom emoji/sticker picker in favor of the stock picker
Fix the picker crashing on scroll for accounts with many favorited packs
Fix a horizontal scrollbar on the picker's category rail and missing hover previews for custom emoji
Restore freeform-text reactions when the custom picker is disabled
Restore the room list's blurred-avatar backdrop and extend it to section headers and the search bar
Fix custom emoji being sent as garbled, escaped HTML
Fix the composer's URL preview lingering after sending or clearing the link
